name: curn_fs30_ab_hybrid
notes: CURN^free screening A/B (docs/FS_PILOT.md Sec. 7), matched arms (same seed, init, metric, warmup): 8 vectorised chains started at seed-41 draws of curn_fs30 with each bin independently moved to the low region [-15, -10] with probability 0.3 (diverse region starts), fixed dense curn_fs30 metric, step-size adaptation for 150 iterations starting at the measured workable 0.02 (curn_fs30 adapted 0.021-0.024), 1500 draws. Stop rule (fixed before launch): abort an arm whose warmup exceeds 15 min or whose projected total exceeds 40 min. Arm B: NUTS + one block-MH sweep per iteration (30 bins + 6 IRN pairs; proposals frozen in configs/m2/proposals/curn_fs30_v1.json, fitted from curn_fs30 only).
